name: Line Text
description: Type text in the editor and it is drawn with thin line objects.

object-id.name: Line Object ID
object-id.description: Object stretched and rotated into each line. Use a plain square deco object with no hitbox (211 by default).

font.name: Default Font
font.description: Font picked when the popup opens for the first time (it then remembers your last choice).

cap-height.name: Default Size (px)
cap-height.description: Height of capital letters in pixels (30 px = 1 block).

thickness.name: Default Line Width (px)
thickness.description: Width of the lines in pixels.

line-spacing.name: Line Spacing (px)
line-spacing.description: Extra space between lines of text (\n).

simplify.name: Curve Simplify (px)
simplify.description: Curves: points closer than this to a straight line are merged, so fewer objects are used. 0 = keep every point (smoothest, most objects).

max-scale.name: Max Object Scale
max-scale.description: Longest stretch for one object. Longer lines are split into several objects.

select-placed.name: Select Placed Objects
select-placed.description: Select the text right after placing so you can move, recolor or group it.
